tasks.title: Reserve scoped submissions before effects
tasks.goal: Prevent duplicate effects across concurrent CLI/MCP/API submits and result-retention expiry.
steps: Add host-issued context/target/principal-scoped submission namespaces with epoch/expiry and atomic idempotency-key/request/plan reservations before effects.
Bind reservation to existing durable domain run/journal IDs; same key/payload attaches, different payload refuses, simultaneous surfaces have one winner.
Retain compact tombstones for live namespaces and pinned active/parked/recovery identities across expiry; reject retired namespaces even after large payload collection.
positive_cases: Concurrent identical submits produce one actual domain invocation.
Lost response followed by retry returns the existing operation outcome.
negative_cases: Collected result permits an old expired key to rerun an uncertain operation.
Caller invents or renews a submission namespace.

tasks.title: Link short-lived operation owners to domain recovery
tasks.goal: Retain inspectable truthful outcomes across API exit, EOF and execution-owner crashes.
steps: Introduce operation handles that bind existing lifecycle/build/deploy/publication journals and retained terminal/partial results without duplicating their authority.
Advertise connection-loss policy; implement continue-to-completion or explicit safe-stop ownership and protected local attach/control for a still-running owner.
On owner crash recover from domain journals, preserving existing one-writer/one-parked limits and completed/pending/uncertain effects; do not synthesize success from EOF.
positive_cases: An operation remains inspectable after the originating API process exits.
A reconnect attaches to a live owner or receives exact recovery-required state.
negative_cases: Connection loss silently restarts a provider.
A second client bypasses the domain's existing execution limit.

tasks.title: Multiplex progress, queries and cooperative controls
tasks.goal: Keep machine sessions responsive during long operations with bounded replay and honest cancellation.
steps: Separate request dispatch from long job execution and stream typed phase/state/progress/diagnostic events with per-stream sequence and context/target references.
Add flow control, bounded raw stdout/stderr and replay cursors; slow consumers receive explicit gaps/expired payload states without losing terminal result identity.

Implement cancellation-requested acknowledgement separately from reached safe stop; queries/control run while a job executes, and cancellation after committed effects returns partial/recovery outcomes.
positive_cases: A long fixture job permits concurrent query and cancellation requests.
Replayed events link to the same durable operation and final result.
negative_cases: Serial tools/call blocks all cancel handling.
Cancel acknowledgement is reported as rollback or an unlimited event queue accumulates.

tasks.title: Expose typed input and admission across all adapters
tasks.goal: Remove machine-mode TTY/prose decisions and fixed startup defaults that hide per-operation capability.
steps: Map domain NeedsSelection/input/approval requests to schemas bound to exact question, plan, scope and policy generation.
Carry explicit force/trace/deploy-profile and supported operation controls as validated requested options, preserving authority rather than silently choosing startup defaults.
Return structured phase and partial effects even when a handler exits without a final report; expose equivalent services through CLI, MCP and local API.
positive_cases: A machine client resolves a typed selection and submits the exact resulting plan.
An authorization refusal includes scope and completed-effect truth.
negative_cases: Free prose or assume-yes is parsed as a blanket grant.
An Err after prior writes is serialized as no effects.
